name: prim-mst
description: Finds a Minimum Spanning Tree of an undirected weighted graph starting from a node using Prim's algorithm.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to compute the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) of a weighted undirected graph starting from an arbitrary root vertex.

parameters.name: graph
parameters.description: Adjacency list where keys are node IDs and values are arrays of { node, weight } objects.

parameters.name: startNode
parameters.description: Optional starting node ID. If omitted, the first key of the graph object is used.
